svg.title: 04 · Analyzer
svg.desc: The analyzer: the KPI gate answers with a preset query or hands the question to the Claim Query Agent, which writes SQL through cli.py and the SQL guard; the query continues on 03.

g.text: Preset fixed SQL · The agent fills in parameters to the preset queries

no keyless joins > 100 M row pairs

svg.text: FAILS A CHECK: ERROR TO THE AGENT
